title: NoMob-Sheeps
description: NoMob-Sheep — Completely removes sheep from your server by preventing spawns and purging existing ones.
body:
# NoMob-Sheep

A lightweight Paper plugin that completely eliminates sheep from your server.
Part of the **NoMob** plugin family — one plugin per mob, drop in only what you need.

## Features

- Prevents all sheep spawns (natural, spawner, or otherwise)
- Removes all existing sheep on startup
- Removes sheep from chunks as they load
- All behaviour is individually configurable
- Shared config stored in `plugins/NoMob/config.yml` across all NoMob plugins
- Reload support via `/nomob reload`

## Configuration

```yaml
sheep:
  removal:
    prevent-spawns: true
    remove-existing: true
    remove-on-chunk-load: true
```

## Commands & Permissions

| Command          | Description               | Permission     |
|------------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| `/nomob reload`  | Reloads the configuration | `nomob.reload` |
| `/nomob version` | Shows the plugin version  | `nomob.reload` |

## Requirements

- Paper 1.21+
